item.title: OCM v0.25.0-rc.1 released
item.description: OCM v0.25.0-rc.1 is available. Release notes and downloads: https://github.com/open-component-model/open-component-model/releases/tag/v0.25.0-rc.1
item.content:encoded:
[0.25.0-rc.1] - 2026-11-13

🚀 Features

  • (ci) Check the controller chart and image build files against CIS Kubernetes and NSA/CISA benchmarks (#3979)
  • (http) Add per-host plainHTTP to the HTTP client configuration (#4155)
  • Add e2e Crossplane Compositions examples for Helm and Kustomize (#3631)

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • (constructor) Preserve resource srcRefs in ocm add cv (#4153)
  • Make bindings/go work on Windows and run unit tests there (#3942)
  • (http) Classify Winsock connection resets as transient (#4218)
  • --logformat not respected in TTY (#4215)
  • (controller) Scope watch reverse lookups to the event namespace (#4209)
  • (sigstore) Use a single-node kind cluster for the scaffolding (#4235)
  • (cli) Keep the interactive progress display when --logformat requests text (#4224)
  • (descriptor) Read the OCM v1 localOciBlob access as a local blob (#4239)
  • (sigstore) Pass --use-signed-timestamps when bundle has RFC3161 timestamp (#4237)
  • (rsa) Accept the signing certificate subject as signature issuer (#4205)

📦 Dependencies

  • (deps) Update module github.com/prometheus/client_golang to v1.25.0 (#4195)
  • (deps) Update ghcr.io/open-component-model/kubernetes/controller:latest docker digest to 5468c8a (#4177)
  • (deps) Update docker dependencies (#4178)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/mattn/go-runewidth to v0.0.31 (#4181)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/aws/smithy-go to v1.28.5 (#4189)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/microsoft/go-winio to v0.6.3 (#4182)
  • (deps) Update golang x repositories (#4193)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/onsi/ginkgo/v2 to v2.33.1 (#4191)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/fxamacker/cbor/v2 to v2.9.6 (#4180)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/emicklei/go-restful/v3 to v3.14.0 (#4192)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/docker/cli to v29.9.0+incompatible (#4194)
  • (deps) Update aws-sdk-go-v2 monorepo (#4188)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/moby/moby/client to v0.6.2 (#4183)
  • (deps) Update go-git to v6.0.0-beta.1 and report missing short refs as not found (#4196)
  • (deps) Bump klauspost/compress and Go toolchain for CVEs (#4217)
  • (deps) Update ocm cosign (patch) (#4220)
  • (deps) Update dependency sigstore/scaffolding to v0.7.41 (#4229)
  • (deps) [breaking] Migrate oras-go from v2 to v3 (#4221)
  • (deps) Update ocm cosign (#4240)
  • (deps) Bump dependencies (#4241)

🚜 Refactor

  • Introduce testutils module (#4167)
  • (http) [breaking] Share one Duration type across configuration types (#4234)
  • (bindings) [breaking] Migrate to encoding/json/v2 and streaming APIs (#4206)

🧪 Testing

  • (controller) Measure the performance benchmark in rollout, drift and update phases (#4202)
  • (cli) Give versioncheck integration tests a longer GitHub API timeout (#4247)
  • (runtime) Walk the module as an fs.FS so the marshal guard matches on windows (#4255)

⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks

  • (test) Add helm-unittest suites for the controller chart (#4064)
  • (controller) Show ready state and identifying columns in kubectl get (#4214)
  • (fix) Windows returns a different error on killing an already stopped process with unix domain socket (#4216)
  • Use a different groupping for the resolution histogram to not spam the metrics server (#4203)
  • (sigstore) Retry transient github.com downloads in integration setup (#4243)

📚 Documentation

  • (cli) Refresh CLI README for the new monorepo layout (#4204)

Get This Release

Install the OCM CLI

curl -sfL https://ocm.software/install-cli.sh | OCM_VERSION=0.25.0-rc.1 bash

For alternative installation options, see the installation guide.

You can also run the OCM CLI in a container without installing it:

docker run --rm -t ghcr.io/open-component-model/cli:0.25.0-rc.1 --help

See the container image guide for more details.

Deploy the OCM Controller

Install into a Kubernetes cluster via Helm:

helm install ocm-k8s-toolkit oci://ghcr.io/open-component-model/kubernetes/controller/chart \
--version 0.25.0-rc.1 \
--namespace ocm-k8s-toolkit-system \
--create-namespace

See the controller setup guide for full configuration options.

OCM Component Distribution (for existing OCM users)

Every OCM release is published as OCM component versions to ghcr.io/open-component-model - the same distribution mechanism OCM enables for your own software. Components in this release:

Component Contents
ocm.software/ocm:0.25.0-rc.1 Product wrapper referencing CLI + controller
ocm.software/cli:0.25.0-rc.1 CLI binaries and OCI image
ocm.software/kubernetes/controller:0.25.0-rc.1 Controller image and Helm chart

Inspect the full product component:

ocm get component-version ghcr.io/open-component-model//ocm.software/ocm:0.25.0-rc.1 -o yaml

Download a CLI binary directly via OCM (requires OCM CLI already installed; replace os and architecture as needed — e.g. linux/amd64, darwin/arm64):

ocm download resource ghcr.io/open-component-model//ocm.software/cli:0.25.0-rc.1 \
--identity os=linux,architecture=amd64

Community & Contributors

This release we had a total of 10 contributors! If you want to engage with us, check our community page!

⚡ Performance

item.content:encoded:
Promoted from v0.23.0-rc.2 on 2026-11-06

[0.23.0] - 2026-11-06

🚀 Features

  • (ci) Harden images against the DISA GPOS SRG and the CIS Docker Benchmark (#3978)
  • (transfer) Transfer unpinned Git resources by value with a drift warning (#4040)
  • (cli) Select default verifier from signature algorithm (#4045)
  • (transfer) Add unmatchedResourcePolicy to the transfer config (#4009)
  • Add performance suite (#3791)
  • (ctf) Stream blobs of unknown digest or size into a CTF via staged files (#4057)
  • (controllers) [breaking] Use OCI cache instead of resolution service (#3829)
  • (wget) [breaking] Stream downloads instead of buffering to a temp file (#3939)
  • (signing) [breaking] Default new signatures to jsonNormalisation/v4alpha3 (#4006)
  • (blob) Add Remove to filesystem.Blob (#4102)
  • (controller) [breaking] Verify resource digests without downloading where possible (#4109)

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • (transfer) Upload legacy OCI artifact sets (#4037)
  • (sigstore) Wait for knative webhook before patching config-network (#4039)
  • (sigstore) Retry knative config-network patch until the webhook answers (#4046)
  • (http) Make transfers survive HTTP/2 connection loss (#4007)
  • Stop reacting to our own create event from the deployer (#4048)
  • Render godoc structure in schema descriptions (#4035)
  • (cli) [breaking] Replace existing component versions by default (#4036)
  • Resolve data races surfaced by go test -race (#4088)
  • (ctf) Recognize docker artifact set media types (#4089)
  • (descriptor) Omit unset component reference digest (#4096)
  • (blob) [breaking] Stop holding an os.Root in read-only OS path blobs (#4087)
  • (oci) Avoid copying extracted tar and write end-of-archive marker (#4083)
  • (oci) Copy nested-manifest local blobs directly between stores (#4079)
  • (blob) Stream single-file path blobs from disk without leaking the file (#4077)
  • (ctf) Don't hold the archive lock while streaming blobs (#4105)
  • (ctf) Make blob staging optional and safe against concurrent publishes (#4108)
  • (repository) [breaking] Bind every downloaded resource to its descriptor digest (#4085)
  • (s3) [breaking] Stream downloads instead of leaving temporary files (#4113)
  • (oci) Join in-flight resolver in refcache Always concurrency test (#4114)
  • (oci) Accept resources excluded from signature on upload (#4164 + #4081) (#4168)

📦 Dependencies

  • (deps) Update module github.com/onsi/gomega to v1.44.0 (#4031)
  • (deps) Update go-openapi packages (#4024)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/klauspost/compress to v1.20.1 (#4026)
  • (deps) Update digest pins (#4022)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/ebitengine/purego to v0.11.1 (#4025)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/pb33f/ordered-map/v2 to v2.3.2 (#4027)
  • (deps) Update kubernetes dependencies to v0.37.1 (#4029)
  • (deps) Update ocm cosign (#4020)
  • (deps) Update aws-sdk-go-v2 monorepo (#4028)
  • (deps) Update ghcr.io/open-component-model/kubernetes/controller:latest docker digest to 31080f0 (#4023)
  • (deps) Update registry docker tag to v3.1.1 (#4062)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 to v4.1.6 [security] (#4073)
  • (deps) Update ocm cosign (#4092)

⚡ Performance

  • (oci) Read legacy artifact sets as OCI layouts without conversion (#4044)
  • (blob) [breaking] Use pooled copy buffers and gzip writers on blob paths (#4058)
  • (oci) Stream OCI image layers lazily instead of loading them into memory (#4080)
  • (blob) Keep io.ReaderAt on direct blob readers for tar extraction (#4084)
  • (blob) Keep io.WriterTo for byte-backed direct blobs (#4082)
  • (oci) Hash a local resource blob once before upload (#4099)
  • (oci) [breaking] Pool chunked push buffers and keep chunked push behind the cache (#4068)

🚜 Refactor

  • (oci) [breaking] Make DescriptorBlob lazy (#4049)

⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks

  • (ci) Fail link checks on PRs for findings outside the diff (#4038)
  • (fix) Stop returning early on a config change (#4050)
  • [breaking] Deprecate component sources (#4047)
  • Slight logical adjustment and documenting the rate limiting and concurrency settings (#4093)

📚 Documentation

  • Clarify that all built-in access types work natively with ocm download (#4052)

Get This Release

Install the OCM CLI

curl -sfL https://ocm.software/install-cli.sh | OCM_VERSION=0.23.0 bash

For alternative installation options, see the installation guide.

You can also run the OCM CLI in a container without installing it:

See the container image guide for more details.

Deploy the OCM Controller

Install into a Kubernetes cluster via Helm:

helm install ocm-k8s-toolkit oci://ghcr.io/open-component-model/kubernetes/controller/chart \
--version 0.23.0 \
--namespace ocm-k8s-toolkit-system \
--create-namespace

See the controller setup guide for full configuration options.
